stem.text: When 2-bromo-2-methylpropane reacts with aqueous sodium hydroxide, an alcohol is formed.
Which diagram describes the first step in the reaction mechanism?

A.alt: Mechanism diagram of (CH3)3C–Br with δ+ on the central C and δ− on Br, with a curly arrow at the C–Br bond.

B.alt: Mechanism diagram of (CH3)3C–Br with δ+ on the central C and δ− on Br, with a curly arrow at the C–Br bond.

C.alt: Mechanism diagram of (CH3)3C–Br with δ+ on the central C and δ− on Br, with a curly arrow from HO- to C and a curly arrow at the C–Br bond.

D.alt: Mechanism diagram of (CH3)3C–Br with δ+ on the central C and δ− on Br, with a curly arrow from HO- to C and a curly arrow at the C–Br bond.
